jobs.title: Founding Product Manager, AI Lab
jobs.description:
About airSlate
airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
 
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Romania, Ukraine, and Philippines. 
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

About the team:
AI Labs is airSlate's bet on what comes after the toolbox era of software. No backlog rituals, no six-month roadmaps, no committees — small teams, weekly ship cycles, real users from day one. We build AI-native products for the businesses that actually run the economy: the contractor booking your kitchen remodel, the dentist scheduling your cleaning, the 10-person shop drowning in W-9s and PDFs nobody designed for them. They've been stuck with decades-old software. We're here to change that, fast.
The opportunity:
For thirty years, software gave people toolboxes — edit this, sign that, file the other thing, one click at a time. AI lets us skip the toolbox entirely and hand people the outcome : taxes filed, contracts signed, staff onboarded, done. That's not an incremental upgrade. It's a chance to make our own products — and everyone else's — obsolete, fast. Whoever builds this first wins a category. We want it to be us, and we want it to be you.
The role:
You'll own an AI-native product end to end — not manage a backlog, not shepherd someone else's roadmap. You work closely with AI Labs' product leader, who sets the broad direction, but everything from "who is this customer, really" to "why is this metric moving" to "ship it tonight" is yours. You'll have a small team of engineers who are good, fast, and looking to you to make the next six months feel like an adventure instead of a slog.
What you'll do:
-
Get obsessed with the customer. Talk to SMB owners, watch them work, mine the signal sitting in our millions of existing users — find the problem they actually have, not the one that's convenient for us.

-
Run on hypotheses, not opinions. Form a sharp bet, design the test, read the result honestly even when it stings, move.

-
Own the funnel and the money. Activation, conversion, retention, monetization — know the numbers cold and push them yourself.

-
Turn mess into a thing worth building. Insight is cheap; a sharp, buildable product decision is not.

-
Build alongside your engineers, not above them. Prototype with AI tools — v0, Cursor, Lovable, whatever's fastest — and fix your own interface instead of filing a ticket for it.

-
Ship in days, not quarters. Idea to something real in front of a user in about a week. Then do it again.

-
Bring the energy that makes people want to build with you. This is the job where "it's just a job" gets you replaced.
Who you are:
-
~3–5 years building software products and shipping V1s that real customers actually used — SMB experience is a strong plus.

-
Customer-obsessed by instinct, not by training — you start from their problem, not our roadmap.

-
AI-native. You use these tools every day, not just on slide decks, and you have sharp instincts for what they can and can't do yet.

-
You've run experiments that mattered — you can name the bet, the test, and what you learned when you were wrong.

-
Curious and genuinely unafraid to be wrong in public. Fast learners who chase the question outrun people who protect their ego.

-
A real nose for product — you can tell good from bad in five minutes, not five meetings.

-
Hands-on by default. Given the choice between a rough prototype and a strategy doc, you build the prototype.

-
Fluent in growth and monetization — funnels, conversion, pricing, the levers that actually move a business, not just a metric.

-
Hungry for freedom on new things — and ready to run with it the moment you get it.
Fair warning on how we hire:
Before we talk about strategy, we're going to ask you to build something — a real prototype, a few hours of work, not a two-week slog. If that sounds like an annoying hoop, this probably isn't your role. If it sounds like the most fun part of the interview, you're exactly who we're looking for.
Why this and not somewhere else:
Startup speed and ownership, backed by a company with 100M+ users, real infrastructure, and the resources to actually support what you build — plus direct access to leadership, because this hire is that important to us. You won't wait for permission. You'll build the thing, watch someone use it, and know within a week if you're onto something real.
What we offer
 
Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
 
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience,  plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
 
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
 
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
 
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
 
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
 
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
About airSlate
airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. 
 
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. 
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.


About pdfFiller team:
We are a passionate and ambitious team of 120+ people on a mission to succeed with our online PDF creator and editor — pdfFiller.
pdfFiller empowers over 10 million users every month to create and edit PDFs, send them for signing, and securely store documents within a single application. Offering unlimited storage, unlimited templates, and cross-platform integration, pdfFiller is the only PDF editor needed to get your document done. Beyond core editing, pdfFiller helps SMB customers move fast on document-based workflows — from invoice templates and lease agreements to online fax and notarization — so they can go fully paperless and focus on running their business, while securely handling financial, legal, and HR-related use cases through e-signature workflows and bulk form response collection.
Now, we are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join us in the next chapter of growth as our brand expands and we bring new products to market.

What you will be working on:
- Own a product track end to end: strategy, discovery, roadmap, delivery and outcome. You decide what problem is worth solving, not only what gets built next.

- Run evidence-led discovery. Customer interviews, support insight, behavioral data and competitive analysis, turned into clear written problem statements and sized opportunities.

- Prioritize against business impact. Make the case for investment in your area, and against work that will not pay off, including your own.

- Ship with your triad. Partner with a designer and an engineering manager to cut work into small increments, write clear requirements, and hold quality, stability and security as non-negotiable.

- Experiment and read the results honestly. Define hypotheses and success metrics before you build, run A/B tests at real scale, and stop what does not work.

- Own your numbers. Define the KPIs for your track, monitor the funnel, and report progress, risk and learnings to product leadership.

- Work across functions and across the portfolio: marketing, support, data, and the sibling products at airSlate.
What we expect from you:
- 5+ years in product management, including at least two owning a self-serve SaaS product, or a significant surface of one, end to end.

- A track record of measurable business outcomes (conversion, activation, retention, ARPU), not a list of shipped features.

- Strong experimentation practice: designing and sizing A/B tests, interpreting results, and acting on negative results.

- Comfort with data: defining metrics, working in a BI tool, reading or writing SQL, forming and testing hypotheses independently.

- Discovery craft: talking to customers directly, and turning what you hear into problem statements a team can act on.

- Product-led growth in a high-volume self-serve funnel: paid acquisition, trial or freemium, activation and monetization.

- Shipping AI features into real user workflows, with a realistic view of where AI adds value and where it does not.

- Ability to work in ambiguity and bring structure to it.

- Comfortable using AI to significantly increase personal productivity.
Nice to have:
- Domain background in documents, workflow automation, e-signature, fintech, HR tech or legal tech.

- SMB or prosumer customers rather than enterprise-only.

- Professional working proficiency in English, B2 to C1 or above. Much of our decision-making happens in writing.

- Polish (B1 to B2) is a plus, not a requirement.
What we offer
 
Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
 
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience,  plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
 
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
 
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
 
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
 
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
 
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About airSlate
airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. 
 
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. 
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.


About SignNow team
We are a passionate and ambitious team of 100+ people on a mission to succeed with our award-winning signature solution, SignNow.
SignNow empowers over 28 million people at companies across the world to move fast with everything they need to send and eSign their documents. Increase productivity with document workflows, impress customers, and save money while maximizing ROI with SignNow.
 
About the role:

As a Senior Product Manager, Core Agreement Features, you will own and evolve the user-facing experiences at the heart of SignNow’s agreement execution journey. You will identify the biggest user pain points in core flows, simplify complex tasks through excellent UX, and use AI capabilities where they meaningfully improve clarity, confidence, and time-to-completion.
A key part of this role is helping users succeed in high-stakes moments where they may not fully understand what is required from a compliance perspective. You will design product experiences that guide users toward the right actions, reduce risk, and increase trust, without overwhelming them.
This role is highly outcome-driven. You will define hypotheses, run A/B tests, and drive measurable business impact. You will collaborate closely with engineering, design, analytics, support, sales, and marketing, and operate with high ownership and independence.

What you will be working on:
- Core user journeys. Own and improve core agreement execution flows, ensuring they are intuitive, fast, and reliable.

-
User problem discovery. Deeply understand user pain points through research, support insights, and behavioral data, then translate them into clear problem statements and priorities.

-
UX simplification. Turn complicated tasks into simple, guided experiences through UX, product design patterns, and smart defaults.

-
AI-powered assistance. Identify opportunities to use AI to reduce friction and improve user confidence, especially in moments where users are unsure what is required. Define guardrails and fallback behavior to maintain trust.

-
Compliance-guided UX. Build product guidance that helps users make correct decisions in compliance-sensitive contexts, even when users are uncertain about what “right” looks like.

-
Experimentation and optimization. Drive measurable business outcomes through A/B testing and iterative improvements. Define hypotheses, success metrics, and clear decisions based on results.

-
Cross-functional execution. Partner closely with engineering and design to deliver high-quality features, and collaborate with support, sales, and marketing to ensure strong adoption and customer outcomes.

-
Metrics and reporting. Define and track KPIs, monitor funnel performance, and build learning loops that continuously improve the product.
What we expect from you:
-
5+ years of product management experience building user-facing B2B or B2C SaaS products.

-
Strong product craft and UX judgment, with a proven ability to simplify complex user journeys.

-
Deep user empathy and a consistent problem-solving approach, you start from user needs and outcomes, not feature delivery.

-
Experience building and optimizing end-to-end user flows, including onboarding, key task completion, and self-serve experiences.

-
Strong experimentation skills, including designing and executing A/B tests, interpreting results, and turning insights into impact.

-
Data-driven decision-making skills, comfortable defining metrics, building dashboards, and using qualitative and quantitative inputs.

-
Good intuition for where AI adds value in user-facing flows, and where it does not, including practical tradeoffs around quality, risk, and user trust.

-
Excellent communication skills, able to align teams and stakeholders across product, engineering, design, data, support, sales, and marketing.

-
Ownership mindset, bias for action, and comfort operating with ambiguity and multiple stakeholders.
Ready to shape a product used by millions? We’d love to hear from you!


What we offer
 
Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
 
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience,  plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
 
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
 
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
 
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
 
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
 
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

jobs.description:
About airSlate
airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. 
 
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. 
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.


About the role
pdfFiller helps millions of customers create, edit, manage, sign and collaborate on documents digitally. We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who can connect what we build with why it matters to customers and how we win in the market.
This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership across positioning, go-to-market strategy, product launches, customer and competitive intelligence, and sales enablement.
We are looking for someone who is equally comfortable developing a positioning strategy, digging into customer and market data, partnering with Product on roadmap decisions, and giving GTM the tools and narratives they need to win.

What you'll be working on:
Own product positioning and messaging

- Develop and continuously refine positioning, messaging and value propositions for pdfFiller across key customer segments and use cases.

- Translate complex product capabilities, including AI-powered functionality, into clear customer benefits and compelling commercial narratives.

- Ensure our positioning is differentiated, evidence-based and consistently reflected across the customer journey.

Lead go-to-market strategy

- Own the product marketing strategy for major launches, new capabilities and strategic initiatives from early planning through adoption.

- Define target audiences, use cases, value propositions, competitive differentiation, launch plans and success measures.

- Partner with Product early in the development process so customer and market insight informs what we build, not simply how we market it after launch.

Develop deep customer and market insight

- Build a strong understanding of pdfFiller customers, prospects, competitors and broader document productivity market.

- Conduct customer research, win/loss analysis, competitive analysis and market segmentation to identify opportunities and inform Product and GTM strategy.

- Turn customer insight and market data into recommendations leaders can act on.

Drive adoption and commercial impact

- Partner with Growth and Lifecycle Marketing to improve activation, adoption, conversion, retention and expansion.

- Identify gaps between product capability and customer understanding and develop strategies to close them.

- Use data to evaluate whether positioning, launches and campaigns are changing customer behavior and contributing to business outcomes.

Enable Sales and customer-facing teams

- Create sales narratives, competitive intelligence, battlecards, customer stories, presentations and other enablement materials that help customer-facing teams communicate pdfFiller's value effectively.

- Partner directly with Sales to understand objections, competitive pressure and customer needs and bring those insights back into Product and Marketing.

Shape product strategy

- Represent the voice of the market in product discussions.

- Partner with Product leaders to evaluate market opportunities, customer problems, competitive dynamics and potential areas of investment.

- Help the organization answer not only "Can we build this?" but "Who is this for, what problem does it solve, and why will customers choose us?"
Requirements:
-
6+ years of experience in consumer and b2b product marketing, preferably within software, productivity tools, document technology or a related technology category

-
Demonstrated ownership of product positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategy

-
Experience bringing new products or major capabilities to market

-
Strong understanding of SaaS customer journeys, including acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and expansion

-
Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales, Growth and other cross-functional teams

-
Strong customer research, market analysis and competitive intelligence capabilities

-
Ability to turn complex technology into simple, compelling customer value

-
Strong commercial judgment and comfort using data to make decisions

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

-
Ability to operate independently in a distributed, international organization
